{{Quote|Tell you what, ''Ord'ika'', fancy some breakfast while the system gets on with unpacking that data? They do a disgustingly greasy fry-up in the Kragget.|Kal Skirata to ARC trooper Captain Ordo Skirata|<ref name="TZ" />}}
The '''Kragget''' was an all-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Taking its name from the [[Armored rat|kragget rats]] that prowled Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]], the Kragget restaurant was situated at the edge of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' lower levels. The Kragget served a selection of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|inexpensive]], greasy breakfast food at all [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the day, including a variety of fried [[Egg/Legends|eggs]], [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat strips, [[roba sausage]], and [[Mealbread/Legends|mealbread]] sticks. Much of the Kragget's business came from repeat customers, and the dining establishment's position near the lawless neighborhoods of the Coruscant underworld made the Kragget a favorite of off-duty [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It's not the Skysitter, but it sets you up for the day.|Kal Skirata|<ref name="TZ" />}}
[[File:Galactic_City.png|thumb|left|280px|The Kragget was located on Coruscant, at the edge of the city world's lower levels.]]
The Kragget was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TZ" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Situated on the edge of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]], the Kragget was an all-day [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] housed within a large, multi-story [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] complex that was also home to a number of apartments.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The front of the restaurant was comprised of wide but grimy [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|windows]] that overlooked a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] walkway<ref name="TZ" /> and nearby [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]]; the transparisteel was interrupted by pair of sliding doors that allowed customers entrance to the Kragget.<ref name="O66" /> Inside, an assortment of benches, booths, and tables were spread about for patrons to sit at,<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> though the tables at the Kragget were often in need of wiping down from previous use.<ref name="TZ" /> The Kragget's kitchen was located at the rear of the restaurant, accessible by doors at the back of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. From there, individuals could make use of a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] or a staircase to reach the overhead apartments housed in the same complex as the Kragget.<ref name="O66" />

Named for the [[Armored rat|kragget rats]] that roamed Coruscant's lower levels,<ref name="TC" /> and reputed for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was both delicious and [[Currency/Legends|inexpensive]],<ref name="TZ" /> the Kragget served breakfast at all [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the day.<ref name="O66" /> However, the Kragget's cuisine was known for being greasy, fat-laden, and generally unhealthy by common [[Human/Legends|Human]] standards. Among the restaurant's selection of foods were fried or smoked strips of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat, [[Mealbread/Legends|mealbread]] sticks, a variety of fried [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]<ref name="TZ" />—including [[werris egg]]s—fried [[roba sausage]], and [[Breadroot patty|breadroot patties]].<ref name="O66" /> One notable meal on the Kragget's menu was known as the "[[Arterial Blocker]]."<ref name="TC" /> The Kragget also offered [[Caf/Legends|caf]] for patrons to drink, by the pot or cup, and tables at the Kragget were furnished with [[Napkin/Legends|napkins]] and [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] for customers to use.<ref name="TZ" /> The Kragget did not perform security checks on customers or any bags in their possession,<ref name="TC" /> and was tended by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Species/Legends|organic]] servers alike.<ref name="TZ" /> Ninety percent of the cantina's business came in the form of regular, repeat clients,<ref name="TC" /> and customers were expected to tip their servers when they dined.<ref name="O66" />

==History==
[[File:CSF_underworld.png|thumb|right|200px|The Kragget was a favored establishment of CSF officers who worked Coruscant's lower levels.]]
{{Quote|I'm a regular at the Kragget and there are plenty of CSF lads using the place, so it's ''secure''.|Kal Skirata|<ref name="TC" />}}
The Kragget restaurant was opened at a point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TZ" /> Due to its location on the edge of Coruscant's lower levels, which contained a number of dangerous and often lawless neighborhoods, the Kragget became a favored dining establishment of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].<ref name="O66" /> Many of the CSF's [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] came to enjoy the fact that the Kragget was close enough to their assigned territory to be able to quickly respond to a call, but far enough away to act as a safe haven from the rigors of the job. The Kragget was considered less prestigious than the [[Skysitter Restaurant/Legends|Skysitter Restaurant]], but over time, it developed a reputation of its own for good, inexpensive food. The restaurant made use of a server [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for some time, though by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Kragget's day shift duties had been taken over by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]]<ref name="TZ" /> named [[Soronna]].<ref name="O66" />

That same year, on the first anniversary of the Clone Wars' opening battle on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|military contractor]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] brought his surrogate son, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], to the Kragget for breakfast. The two celebrated their survival of the war's first year, and made plans for an upcoming [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|anti-terrorist operation]] they meant to conduct on Coruscant in the coming [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. While there, Skirata and Ordo enjoyed a meal of fried eggs, smoked nerf slices, and several cups of caf, all the while they were attended to<ref name="TZ" /> by the waitress Soronna.<ref name="O66" /> Seventeen days later, Skirata returned to the Kragget, this time with Coruscant [[Planetary Security Forces|Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]]. The two sat with their backs to the wall, looking out the transparisteel front of the Kragget while sharing a meal of eggs, each apprising the other of recent developments in the now ongoing counter-[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] operation. The working breakfast came to an end when the [[Jabiimi]] terrorist cell they hoped to foil contacted Skirata—undercover and known to them as a dealer of [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] explosive—looking to establish a meeting. In keeping with a good luck ritual of his, Obrim took it upon himself to pay for both men's meals, and insisted that Skirata come back alive so that he could eventually return the favor.<ref name="TZ" />

[[File:Kal_Skirata.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Kal Skirata was a regular customer of the Kragget.]]
During the mission to take down the [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiimi]] terrorists, Skirata and his team of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] operated out of [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] and [[Tapcafe/Legends|bar]] in the Coruscant [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|entertainment district]]. While there, a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] known as [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] entered into a relationship with a young Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|woman]] by the name of [[Laseema]], the Hut's [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]<ref name="TZ" /> and dancer.<ref name="O66" /> However, Laseema was mistreated by the bar's [[Qibbu|owner]],<ref name="TC" /> leading Skirata to purchase a large, [[Laseema's apartment|floor-spanning apartment]] located over the Kragget for Laseema to move into. Though she accepted Skirata's initial generosity, Laseema insisted on taking a job at the Kragget restaurant in order to earn her keep. The spacious apartment and the restaurant below became an improvised safehouse and meeting place for Skirata and his associates.<ref name="O66" /> Skirata later moved into one of the apartment's rooms in order to house and care for his adopted grandson, [[Venku Skirata|Venku]], looking after the child in the absence of Venku's [[Parent/Legends|parents]], the active-duty [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commando [[Darman Skirata|Darman]], and the frontline [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]].<ref name="TC" />

Five hundred forty-eight days after the start of the Clone Wars, Skirata met with the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] at the Kragget to discuss his recent departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. No longer a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and unable to return to his [[Jedi Temple/Legends|old home]], Skirata offered Jusik residence at the loft apartment over the Kragget, and enlisted his aid in his plans to help the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. During their meeting, Skirata ordered the Kragget's "Arterial Blocker" meal with an extra egg, while Jusik enjoyed some caf and a plate of hot food of his own.<ref name="TC" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after returning to Coruscant from a recent deployment, Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] Etain Tur-Mukan stopped into the Kragget to visit with her son, Venku. While waiting for Venku to return from a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|shopping]] trip with Laseema, Tur-Mukan took a seat at one of the Kragget's tables and enjoyed her usual cup of caf. When Laseema and Venku arrived, several of the Kragget's CSF patrons fawned over the baby there in the restaurant, though it wasn't long before Laseema and Tur-Mukan departed to the Twi'lek's upstairs apartment in order to allow mother and child a chance to spend some time together alone. Nearly two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Kal Skirata again met up with Jaller Obrim at the Kragget. While there, the two witnessed a male customer accost Laseema while she was working, prompting the Twi'lek waitress to draw a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] on the man, pinning his [[Limb/Legends|arm]] to his table via his [[Shirt|sleeve]] and warning him against any further harassment. Faced with a hostile response from both Laseema and the Kragget's numerous CSF customers—who had drawn their [[Blaster/Legends|service weapons]] at the onset of the violent commotion—the man hastily removed himself from his booth once Laseema withdrew her knife, and quickly departed the Kragget.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:Etain_suvudu.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan took temporary refuge in the Kragget after the issuance of Order 66.]]
One thousand and thirty-four days into the Clone Wars, Kal Skirata sat down with his Mandalorian contemporary and former ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' colleague [[Mij Gilamar]] for breakfast at the Kragget. Against his better judgment as a medical [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], Gilamar enjoyed a large meal of unhealthy fried foods that consisted of werris eggs and an assortment of fried meats, including [[Roba/Legends|roba]] [[Sausage/Legends|sausages]]. Gilamar made use of a breadroot patty to soak up the leftover melted roba fat and egg yolk from his plate, before eating that as well. Just over a month later, when Skirata returned to the Kragget, he found his apartment over the restaurant completely emptied, and Laseema, Jusik, and the young Venku gone. Minutes later, not far from the Kragget, Jaller Obrim intercepted a distraught Skirata and explained that the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] had issued a warrant for the Mandalorian soldier's [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]]; the apartment over the Kragget had been cleaned out and the tenants relocated to a safe place by Obrim in order to avoid [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]].<ref name="O66" />

In the wake of the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]—one of the Grand Army of the Republic's [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency orders]], responsible for labeling the army's Jedi officers traitors to the Republic—and the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] ordered [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Coruscant entered into an emergency state, with army and police units patrolling [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] for Jedi fugitives. Arriving on Coruscant from the ongoing [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|battle]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] amid the chaos, Etain Tur-Mukan sought temporary shelter at the Kragget. There, she was taken into the kitchens at the back of the restaurant by Soronna the waitress, who offered her a change of civilian clothes. Once Tur-Mukan was out of her [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], Soronna gathered the garments and threw them in the Kragget's trash [[Incinerator (weapon)|incinerator]]. Thanking the Twi'lek woman for her kindness, Tur-Mukan set out through the front of the restaurant, but was stopped at the door by a CSF officer. Against his standing orders, the officer kept the young woman from being spotted by a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|military gunship]] passing by on patrol, then wished the fugitive Jedi luck as Tur-Mukan left the Kragget.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kragget was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via an appearance in the second entry in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel series, [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 28]], [[2006]]. The restaurant appeared again in Traviss' subsequent ''Republic Commando'' novel, [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], published [[October 30]], [[2007]], and its sequel, [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], released [[September 16]], [[2008]].
